pictures.observed: Viewed1280px southern range: two-storey stock brick/sash lights/red flat arches/white bands and gables, black transit shutters and smaller silver cap. Large green equatorial dome is separate.

pictures.author: Elliott Brown
pictures.observed: Viewed1280px north/east entrance: three true lower brick arches/recesses, upper arched central sash, white bands and pediment/modillions; lettering/banners omitted.

pictures.observed: Viewed1280px north courtyard: gabled transit room with tall dark shutters/white strips/narrow doorway, sash side lights, low weathered tile roof with roof slot, higher brick gallery/pediments/small silver cap. Imprecise Flamsteed caption not used for building assignment; no copied courtyard inscription/signs.
